params.name: organization_id
params.description: Enter the organization ID of the companies you are searching for. Ensure that the access token used for authentication has the correct permissions to search for companies in the given organization.

params.name: before
params.description: Lower bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [after] or [offset]).

params.name: after
params.description: Upper bound of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [offset]).

params.name: offset
params.description: Offset of the page of data to return (cannot be used together with [before] or [after]).

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum amount of items to return.

params.name: sorting_keys
params.description: The keys to sort the results by.

params.name: sorting_order
params.description: The order to sort the results by. Must be the same length as [sortingKeys]; one order per key.

items.docs: Use this endpoint to search for companies associated with a specific organisation.
Search for a specific company by company ID.
